questions.q: The sum of the infinite series $\frac{1}{5}(\frac{1}{5}-\frac{1}{7})+(\frac{1}{5})^2((\frac{1}{5})^2-(\frac{1}{7})^2)+(\frac{1}{5})^3((\frac{1}{5})^3-(\frac{1}{7})^3)+\cdots$ is equal to
questions.explain: The series can be rewritten as $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (\frac{1}{5})^n [(\frac{1}{5})^n - (\frac{1}{7})^n] = \sum (\frac{1}{25})^n - \sum (\frac{1}{35})^n$. Both are infinite geometric series. The sum of the first is $\frac{1/25}{1-1/25} = \frac{1/25}{24/25} = 1/24$. The sum of the second is $\frac{1/35}{1-1/35} = \frac{1/35}{34/35} = 1/34$. The total sum is $\frac{1}{24} - \frac{1}{34} = \frac{34-24}{24 \times 34} = \frac{10}{816} = \frac{5}{408}$.
